$comment: Mirror of sprk_analysisaction.sprk_inputschema for invoice-firm-notice (ebilling-r1 task 131, FR-50, D-60). The Action is a Linear AI Consumer reached only through IInvoiceAi.DraftFirmNoticeAsync (the Binding carries no tool description, so it is never loop-projected); the schema documents the operand the facade sends as the '## Input' section ({ outcome, findings }) and is validated by CatalogInputSchemaContractTests like every other mirror. NO numeric property anywhere (FR-50): amounts, line references and clause quotes are inserted by the application, never sent. Property-level "required": true is FORBIDDEN (use the object-level required array). actionCode carries NO version suffix. The tenant id travels in the LinearRunContext, never in the operand. Deployed to the row by scripts/ebilling/Ensure-ActionRow.ps1.

findings.description: A short summary of the findings (at most twenty distinct entries). Never carries an amount, a clause or a figure the application inserts.

ruleSetName.description: Always blank: the notice never names a rule set. The model is told to ignore it.

ruleName.description: The rule's name when the firm may be told it (the rule is published to firms); otherwise blank.

consequence.description: The kind of finding: Reduced, Disallowed, Added, Adjustment or RejectionFinding.

issue.description: One plain sentence with no amount or line number.
